description: A utility module that provides a function to convert snake_case or underscored keys into human-friendly Title Case labels for display purposes. The core function, formatLabel, replaces underscores with spaces, capitalizes words, and handles common acronyms for better readability.

methods.name: formatLabel(key)
methods.description: Converts a snake_case or underscored label into Title Case with spaces. Replaces underscores/spaces with a single space, capitalizes each word, and uppercases common acronyms for display.
